$comment: This app, as Fact Explorer sees it. See credit-assistant/fact-explorer.app.json for the
mechanism; Fact Explorer's scripts/build-registry.mjs globs ../*/fact-explorer.app.json, so this
file is the whole of the registration. Keep in step with src/main/scala/gov/irs/twe/Main.scala
This app is the one that proves the registry is not credit-assistant-shaped: it has no scenarios
at all, and it registers a flow node type the scaffold has never heard of. Both are declared
below rather than special-cased in Fact Explorer.
label: Tax Withholding Estimator
$comment_customFlowTags: Mirrors FormativeApp.nodeTypes in Main.scala. A tag listed here reaches the graph as a real
node and passes validate(); one that is not is dropped by the generator. The two input types
TWE also registers (single-checkbox, date) need no declaration — inputType is a free string on
FlowElement, and only tags are validated.
